MODE 2-4: ln X

Logarithmic regression y = A + B ln x.

keys
MODE→2→4

Diminishing-return / log-x relationships (x > 0).

formula
y=A+Blnx

Steep at first, then flattening. Every x value must be positive.

steps

Open this type

  1. MODE→2→4
  2. Clear or edit data in the Statistics Editor as needed
  3. AC, then SHIFT 1 (STAT) for Var / Reg / MinMax recalls
